thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected: context-cache OOM spike on hosted-prod-5. Severity: P1. Auto-pager triggered. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/context-cache-oom 

emma (oncall): ack — I'm on hosted-prod-5 now, pulling logs. seeing repeated "kv_cache_eviction: oom" entries. CPU ok, memory climbing steadily.

raj: +1, I can confirm high mem usage correlating with a surge of very long single-session inputs (60k+ token prompts) hitting continuous batching.

priya: any customer-facing 5xxs? cs-team, do you have reports?

cs-team: yes — two customers reported API 502/504s and elevated latency. Ticket #INC-6521 opened.

emma (oncall): temp mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching on hosted-prod-5 for model-group `mosaic-v2*`; 2) set per-session kv cache cap to 8k tokens; 3) enable aggressive eviction policy for new sessions. Executing step 1 now.

ops-shipit: issuing feature flag flip:  
```\ncurl -X POST https://control-plane/flags/continuous_batching/flip \n  -d '{"env":"hosted-prod-5","enabled":false}' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
ops-shipit: done — feature flag acknowledged. Observability will take ~30s to reflect.

emma (oncall): applying session cap via runtime config:  
```\nPATCH /v1/runtime/config hosted-prod-5
payload: {"kv_cache_max_tokens_per_session": 8192}
```
emma (oncall): cap applied. forcing immediate eviction of sessions above cap.

mike (sre): tailing logs — eviction entries starting at 4332109942, memory usage trending down slowly. No crashes observed after cap and batching disable.

raj: good. can we also push a hotfix to batch-window to reduce in-flight aggregation? current batch_window_ms=50, propose 10ms for this cluster.

priya: agree — smaller batch window should reduce KV amplification on long prompts. I can cut a ship-it.

priya: creating patch, running quick unit sanity then rolling to hosted-prod-5 canary.

priya: canary deploy started -> logs: batch_window_ms=10 applied to 2/12 pods. Monitoring latencies.

emma (oncall): telemetry shows request latency stable for normal requests, and reduced memory pressure for long sessions on canary. Rolling change to remaining pods.

incident-bot: NOTE: automatic escalation to infra lead at 4332110100 due to P1.

mike (sre): rolling complete. memory usage now at baseline. No additional OOMs in last 7 minutes.

cs-team: customer update prepared: "We're investigating intermittent 5xxs earlier today caused by unusually long single-request contexts triggering memory pressure. We applied mitigations and are monitoring. ETA for full postmortem 24h." Ready to send after you approve.

emma (oncall): good to send. include mitigation summary: disabled continuous batching on affected cohort, enforced per-session kv cap, tightened batch window.

raj: root-cause hypothesis: continuous batching + long single-session inputs created KV amplification where batched attention retained extremely long KV chains per request, blowing cache and triggering OOM. Secondary factor: a recent perf tweak extended max_retained_kv_entries for optimizing reuse — that change amplified memory growth under these input distributions.

priya: action items (short):  
- revert/adjust the recent max_retained_kv_entries perf tweak (pr in flight)  
- add input-length-based dynamic batching throttle  
- add alert to detect fast-growing per-pod kv-map size (threshold + slope)  
- customer follow-ups for affected accounts

mike (sre): I'll own the alert and immediate rollback PR; raj can own the dynamic throttle design; priya will finish the perf tweak revert PR and ship tests. Emma to coordinate postmortem.

emma (oncall): handing off to night oncall — @mike (sre) will be primary. I'm leaving notes in incident doc and adding play-by-play. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

mike (sre): ack, taking over. Will keep monitoring for 1h then escalate if regressions.

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: mitigations applied, memory stable, status -> Monitoring. Next update in 30m or on-change.

emma (oncall): postmortem owner: emma. ETA draft in 12h.

cs-team: we've sent the customer statement. Customer replies: appreciate the quick response, will report if they see recurrence.

priya: logging note: add kv-map size and batch_window_ms to sampling logs for long requests so we can reproduce at scale.

raj: small config follow-up: add a soft limit before eviction to help with graceful degradation (e.g., prefer to reject new long sessions vs OOM).

mike (sre): noted. creating follow-up Jira tasks. handing back to incident triage thread.

emma (oncall): closing live mitigation — marking incident as "mitigated" in pager. will continue with postmortem and longer-term fixes.
